sourceFindings.finding: The original test did not await repository preservation/export completion. It waited for the session to finish and for one terminal change set (turn-changed-files-helpers.ts:64-103), listed the change set/repository/file metadata (turn-changed-files-executors.spec.ts:41-63), then polled canonical content GET for HTTP 200 (turn-changed-files-helpers.ts:105-130). That is content availability, not the repository content-complete contract.

There is an existing readiness API: the turn history response includes per-repository availability and content_complete. DTO projection is explicit (turn_changes.go:40-58, 118-132). content_complete is set only after the selected preservation/export path completes: archive/common preservation writes source/readiness and completion in coordinator_finish.go:558-604 and changes/content.go:200-220, 277-305; SQL export page settles file payloads and export progress transactionally in sqlite/turn_change_export_progress.go:99-150. The target now polls exact change-set/repository identity for availability=ready and content_complete=true before container removal.

The old canonical content GET is not a safe readiness probe and is not read-only transitively. ContentService.Read acquires a retention lease, reads a source, then releases the lease (content.go:498-543); Acquire inserts a committed row and Release deletes it (turn_change_content.go:624-669). The route does not invoke export/preservation or write rendered content. It may read from common Git, archived Git, or SQL (content.go:525-543); Git patch rendering can use a temporary directory removed after the read (git_history_read.go:34-64, 219-260). The test no longer issues a pre-removal content GET.

Metadata and durable content are not published as one overall operation: comparison/file inventory is published before content preservation settles (coordinator_finish.go:508-545; spec explicitly separates comparison from preservation). For SQL export, each page's payload links, per-file readiness, receipt, and repository export progress commit in one transaction (turn_change_export_progress.go:99-150; turn_change_content.go:285-326). This does not make the earlier pending inventory atomic with later payload. Git archive installation and subsequent database readiness updates are ordered across storage layers, not a single cross-store transaction.

The replacement readiness poll is a read-only API path: the history service reads the session and change rows; SQLite history/repository listing uses r.ro SELECTs (turn_changes.go:234-270, 373-390). This polling does not cause export or materialization. The E2E testing guidance recommends expect.poll against the backend state for causal waits (apps/web/AGENTS.md, Testing notes).
